⚡ BOXOFFY CALL — Mar 25, 2026 · D7 Wednesday Pending
D7 Wednesday ~₹50 Cr Boxoffy Call · Ram Navami D8 Thursday Holiday Boost Incoming
D7 Wednesday actuals are yet to be reported (morning of March 25). Sacnilk page shows "yet to be reported." AddaToday confirms "morning update to be updated." Based on the weekday trend — D5 ₹65 Cr (–43% from D4), D6 ₹56.55 Cr (–13%) — Boxoffy projects ~₹50 Cr for D7 (–11.5% typical mid-week pattern). That would take the D0–D7 cumulative to ~₹610.67 Cr India nett. Ram Navami falls on D8 Thursday March 26, a national holiday in large parts of India — expect a significant uplift, potentially back to ₹70–80 Cr range. Week 1 total (D0–D8) could cross ₹700 Cr India nett if Ram Navami holds. Per Deadline: $81M global 5-day is the second-biggest Indian opening ever behind Pushpa 2 ($97.9M). NA 5-day $14M at 987 sites is the all-time Bollywood North America record per Exhibitor Relations.
Sources: AddaToday · Sacnilk (D7 pending) · Deadline · Exhibitor Relations · Updated 9:00 AM Mar 25, 2026 · D7 actuals expected Mar 26 morning
✅ UPDATE — Mar 24, 2026 · Boxoffy Intelligence
D5 Monday ₹65 Cr Confirmed · D6 Tuesday ₹56.55 Cr · D0–D7 Total ₹620.67 Cr India Nett
D5 Monday is now confirmed at ₹65 Cr — the highest first Monday for any Bollywood film, surpassing Tiger 3's ₹59.25 Cr (holiday-aided). Sources: Sacnilk, The Week, Republic World, Zee News, DNA — all aligned at ₹65 Cr. D6 Tuesday delivered ₹56.55 Cr (–13% from D5), a remarkably shallow weekday drop driven by strong evening occupancy. The 7-day India nett stands at ₹620.67 Cr. WW gross crossing ~₹980 Cr in 6 days. Week 1 (D0–D7) targeting ₹600+ Cr nett — the biggest opening week in Hindi cinema history, ahead of Pushpa 2's Hindi Week 1 of ₹425 Cr. Ram Navami (D8 Thursday) expected to provide a further lift.
Sources: Sacnilk · Filmibeat · Republic World · The Week · Box Office Worldwide · Updated 11:30 PM Mar 24, 2026
